company.shortDescription: GitButler is a Git client that manages multiple branches and supports virtual branches for efficient workflow.
company.description: GitButler is a software company that provides a Git client designed to manage multiple branches simultaneously. It enhances existing workflows by allowing users to organize file changes into separate branches efficiently. GitButler supports virtual branches, enabling work on branches without relying on local main or master branches. The platform also offers features like first-class conflict management to simplify rebasing processes.

productsAndServices.description: A Git client that manages multiple branches and supports virtual branches to facilitate workflow management.
